title: Principal Engineer - Systems Protection, Relay Settings
description:
Position Overview:
**Power your future with Qualus** as a Principal Relay Settings Engineer. In this role you will perform Protective Relay Design \& Coordination: Design, specify, calculate settings, and coordinate protective relays and relay control schemes. Do you have 12\+ years of Relay Settings experience in major utility substations and generation interconnections? If yes, we want to hear from you!  

Responsibilities:
* Design, specification, setting calculation, and coordination of protective relaying and relay control schemes.
* Modeling, short circuit and overstressed breaker studies as well as the protective relaying recommendations for proposed generation interconnections to a client’s electrical system.
* Ensures all relay settings activities, initiatives, and processes are in conformance with the company’s established policies and objectives, and with client design standards.
* Confidently and comfortably present technical solutions to key customers respond in real time to technical concerns and answer questions in a knowledgeable, articulate manner.
* Work collaboratively with the appropriate groups/ individuals in Qualus to develop and implement technical solutions that support the objectives of the Engineering Department.
* Support multiple projects in parallel.


Minimum Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) with a power systems focus. An MS Degree in engineering will be considered in lieu of the BS Engineering degree. International Engineering Degrees will be considered from an ABET accredited school.
* 12\+ years of experience in protection and control engineering and relay settings.
* Must have demonstrated experience with CAPE and/or ASPEN.
* Professional Engineering (PE) registration is required
* Professional Engineering registration in the working state a plus.
* Must have strong analytical and computer skills.
* Must be able to identify necessary software to complete needed design work.
* Strong communication

title: 26-0086-013 — Scientific Advisor: Resilient Infrastructure and Installations — ERDC (Consulting, Contingent)
description:
**Paid, low\-volume advisory consulting — contingent opportunity.** Axyde Analytics is recruiting a named, non\-government Scientific Advisor for its proposed ERDC Fellowship Program Administration and Research Support team. This is advance recruiting for Axyde, not a Government appointment or an awarded/funded position. Selection and any future work depend on need, funding, applicable contract requirements and a mutually agreed written engagement.

**Engagement and compensation:** Occasional scheduled consultations, short technical reviews and mentoring or recruiting\-advice assignments. Low\-volume, nonexclusive consulting rather than a full\-time role; no minimum hours or work volume is guaranteed. Compensation will be an agreed honorarium for a discrete permitted activity or a negotiated consulting fee for an authorized assignment. Scope, fee and any travel reimbursement must be agreed before work starts. No unpaid project deliverables are requested with an application.

**Location:** Remote advisory consultations are anticipated. Midlothian, Virginia is Axyde's administrative base. Any travel or onsite activity would be separately agreed and subject to facility/task\-order requirements.

### **Scientific Advisor — Resilient Infrastructure and Installations**

**Technical focus:** Infrastructure risk, resilience and lifecycle assessment; installation and community systems; buildings, transportation, energy/water dependencies, hazard adaptation and recovery.

**Directly relevant experience:** Research or applied leadership in civil/infrastructure engineering, resilience, installation planning, asset management or infrastructure systems analysis.

### **Shared advisory responsibilities**

* Advise the Axyde Program Director and recruiting team on discipline\-specific research profiles, relevant methods and realistic experience criteria.
* Identify appropriate university, postdoctoral and professional recruiting channels and facilitate introductions when authorized
